name: Twin Peaks
slug: A familiar mountain range on the way to Langdale, where Gerk has friends.
description: Mountain range on the route between the wider world and Langdale. Gerk has been there often, has friends there, and holds fond memories of it. The tavern they mean sits on a busy street if entered by the front door.

log.summary: Gerk remembers Twin Peaks more clearly than the frozen gatehouse at Volga. Sylan suggests a short visit once this training is done, possibly to say hello or have lunch. They had told people they would be in the forest.
notes: Gerk has been there often and has friends and fond memories there. He remembers it better than the frozen gatehouse at Volga. The tavern they mean sits on a busy street if entered by the front door.
Sylan suggests a short visit, possibly to say hello or have lunch, once this training is done. They had told people they would be in the forest.
